verdict: 1 of 2. The half-life 2y confirmation arm LOST badly: -7.76% at 32.9% drawdown against a +22.36% control at 17.9%. Exam 1's win was the draw, exactly as the ensemble's was. No sealed reading. The exploratory 1y arm beat the control (+24.92%) but adopts nothing by pre-registration - it would have to win its own two exams, and its 25.9% drawdown against the control's 17.9% is not a promising start.
